'''Weesin''' is a small village in [[Altara]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Weesin|Weesin}} It is located north of [[Ebou Dar]] along the [[Great North Road]].{{ref||Weesin}}

Even though [[Valan Luca]] describes the village as "flyspeck," he still wants to stop his [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|show]] to perform.{{ref/book|10|28}}
